message.content:
Build the Email Outreach feature for Rankora. 

## 1. DB Migration
Create `supabase/migrations/20260318180000_add_outreach_log.sql`:
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.outreach_log (
  id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  resume_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  job_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  sent_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  to_address text,
  subject text,
  status text DEFAULT 'sent',
  user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id)
);

ALTER TABLE public.outreach_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Users can view own outreach" ON public.outreach_log
  FOR SELECT USING (user_id = auth.uid());
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own outreach" ON public.outreach_log
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outreach_log_user_id ON public.outreach_log(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outreach_log_resume_id ON public.outreach_log(resume_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outreach_log_job_id ON public.outreach_log(job_id);
```

## 2. Edge Function
Create `supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts`.

First, READ `supabase/functions/send-email/index.ts` to understand the existing Postmark email sending pattern. Follow the EXACT same patterns for auth, CORS, Supabase client.

The function should:
- Auth: JWT verification
- Input: `{ resume_id, job_id, to_email, subject, body_html }`
- Send email via the existing Postmark pattern (copy the API call pattern from send-email)
- Log to outreach_log table
- Return success/failure

Use `POSTMARK_API_TOKEN` or the same env var name used in send-email function. Read send-email to find the exact env var name and API URL.

## 3. Frontend Dialog
Create `src/components/candidate/EmailOutreachDialog.tsx`:

```typescript
interface EmailOutreachDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  candidateName: string;
  candidateEmail: string;
  jobTitle: string;
  matchScore: number;
  resumeId: string;
  jobId: string;
}
```

- Uses shadcn Dialog
- Shows: To (pre-filled, read-only), Subject (editable, pre-filled), Body (editable textarea, pre-filled with template)
- Template variables: {{candidate_name}}, {{job_title}}, {{match_score}}
- Default template: "Hi {{candidate_name}},\n\nWe reviewed your application for the {{job_title}} position and were impressed with your profile ({{match_score}}% match).\n\nWe'd love to discuss this opportunity further. Would you be available for a brief call this week?\n\nBest regards"
- "Send Email" button → calls supabase.functions.invoke("send-candidate-email", ...)
- "Open in Email Client" fallback button → mailto: link
- Loading state while sending
- Success toast on send

## 4. Integration
Read `src/components/CandidateRow.tsx`. Find the Email button (the mailto: link with Mail icon). 
- Add state for the dialog: `const [emailDialogOpen, setEmailDialogOpen] = useState(false)`
- Change the email button to open the dialog instead of mailto: when email exists
- Render the EmailOutreachDialog at the bottom of the component
- Pass all required props

Also update the phone button tooltip to say "Copy phone" on desktop instead of showing the raw phone number.

IMPORTANT:
- Use @/ imports
- Use shadcn components (Dialog, Button, Input, Textarea, Label)
- Use sonner toast
- Run `npm run build` after all changes

---

## Files Created / Modified

### 1. DB Migration
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/supabase/migrations/20260318180000_add_outreach_log.sql`

Creates the `outreach_log` table with RLS policies that restrict each user to their own rows, plus three indexes on `user_id`, `resume_id`, and `job_id`.

### 2. Edge Function
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts`

Follows the exact same pattern as `send-email`: CORS headers, service-role Supabase client, JWT verification via `supabase.auth.getUser(token)`, reads `platform_config` for `postmark_api_token` / `email_from_address` / `email_from_name` / `outbound_email_enabled`, sends via the Postmark `/email` API, then inserts a row into `outreach_log` with either `status: "sent"` or `status: "failed"`.

### 3. Dialog Component
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/src/components/candidate/EmailOutreachDialog.tsx`

- Pre-fills To (read-only), Subject, and Body from the candidate/job context
- Default template uses `candidateName`, `jobTitle`, and `matchScore` directly (no raw `{{}}` placeholders in the final rendered text)
- "Send Email" button calls `supabase.functions.invoke("send-candidate-email", ...)` with loading state and `toast.success`/`toast.error` feedback
- "Open in Email Client" fallback button generates a `mailto:` href from the current subject and body
- Resets fields to defaults each time the dialog opens

### 4. CandidateRow Integration
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/src/components/CandidateRow.tsx`

- Added `useState(false)` for `emailDialogOpen`
- Email button now calls `setEmailDialogOpen(true)` instead of wrapping a `mailto:` anchor; tooltip shows "Send email" when email exists
- Phone tooltip already showed "Copy phone" on desktop (the existing conditional was already correct — confirmed in the read)
- `EmailOutreachDialog` rendered at the bottom of the return fragment, guarded by `r.candidate_email` check, passing `r.resume_id` and `r.id` as `resumeId`/`jobId`
